# Script to run MACSE for a codon-aware alignment. 

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH -J MACSE_auto
#SBATCH --mail-type FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user Julia.Levinstein@campus.lmu.de
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00:00
#SBATCH --clusters=biohpc_gen
#SBATCH --partition=biohpc_gen_normal
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH -n 1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4

#configuration

GENES="autosomal_genes" #ancestral_genes or neo_genes
CLADE="Meliphagidae"
INPUT_DIR="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating/$CLADE/$GENES/PAML_constraint_str"
MACSE="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating/Scripts/macse.jar"



#load java
module load openjdk/21.0.3_9

# Loop through each gene directory inside the INPUT_DIR
for GENE_DIR in "$INPUT_DIR"/*/; do
    [ -d "$GENE_DIR" ] || continue

    # Get the gene name from the directory name
    GENE=$(basename "$GENE_DIR")

    # Define the input file path (GeneName/GeneName.fasta)
    FASTA="$GENE_DIR/${GENE}.fasta"

    # Check if the input file exists before proceeding
    if [ ! -f "$FASTA" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $FASTA not found, skipping."
        continue
    fi

    # Check if alignment already exists (saving output back into the gene directory)
    if [ -f "$GENE_DIR/${GENE}_NT.fasta" ]; then
        echo "Skipping $GENE: Alignment already exists."
        continue
    fi

    echo "Aligning $GENE..."
    java -jar "$MACSE" -prog alignSequences \
         -seq "$FASTA" \
         -out_NT "$GENE_DIR/${GENE}_NT.fasta" \
         -out_AA "$GENE_DIR/${GENE}_AA.fasta"
done



```
